_about: Homepage settings per deck folder, read by build-index.mjs and build-home-covers.mjs. Text: title, subtitle, event, meta (place and date) override what the deck's title slide says; set a field to null to hide it. Published decks are frozen, so their homepage text is corrected here, not in the deck. Cover: an image inside the deck (src), cropped to 4:3 like CSS object-position (position, default centre), optionally enlarged (zoom). Without a cover the title slide is used. Run npm run build:covers after changing a cover.
